title: T-3 hibernate-and-wake round-trip preserves storage and doWakeUp fires exactly once
asA: developer whose HubObject hibernates when idle and wakes on the next message
iWant: the wake handler to run from cold and read the same lastBroadcast key from storage the pre-hibernate state persisted
soThat: a re-emerging client can catch up on the missed broadcast without a full re-sync

acceptanceCriteria.description: A HubObject that has processed a broadcast, hibernated (doHibernate emitted), and then woken (doWakeUp emitted once) resolves wake() with lastBroadcast equal to the serialised outbound payload. A second wake() resolves with alreadyAwake=true and the same lastBroadcast; no second doWakeUp fires.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a HubObject with a persisted lastBroadcast that has hibernated
acceptanceCriteria.when: wake() is called once, then again
acceptanceCriteria.then: the first wake emits doWakeUp once and returns lastBroadcast; the second wake reports alreadyAwake without a second event
